brief:
The Guardian's Steve Bloomfield argues that Israel's war in Gaza has fundamentally altered international geopolitics beyond the region itself. Violence has spread across the Middle East, extending from Lebanon to Yemen, while Western nations have forfeited political credibility they once wielded globally, according to Bloomfield's analysis.

The columnist marks October 7, 2023, as a dividing line between two distinct eras in world affairs, suggesting the conflict has triggered cascading consequences far beyond Israeli-Palestinian territory.
dek: A whirlpool of violence has engulfed everywhere from Lebanon to Yemen. Meanwhile, the west has destroyed any political authority it once had There was a world before 7 October, 2023, and now there is a world after.
title: Three years of Gaza war reshapes global order, analyst says
